data.title: The Berkeley
data.about:
Berkeley at Dubai Hills Estate is an outstanding 11-storey residential project by Soho Development. It features 116 residences in studios and 1 and 2-bedroom configurations. 

The development sets a new standard for hotel-inspired living with exceptional amenities for the residents. Renowned brands like Egger from Germany,  Blum & Salice from Austria, and Snaidero from Italy contribute to the high-quality finishes and fixtures in the building.

This multi-purpose tower features expansive parks, a championship golf course, and the iconic Dubai Hills Park. The nearby Dubai Hills Mall provides a premier shopping experience, and quality education is easily accessible with several reputable schools nearby.

characteristics_module.title: Strong Investment Potential With a Commitment to Excellence.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• High-quality finishes and fixtures from renowned brands such as Blum & Salice, Egger, and Snaidero.
  • Thoughtfully designed spaces with state-of-the-art appliances elevate everyday living.
  • Exceptional amenities like an Azure pool and a sun deck with breathtaking views.
  • Located within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate, it offers an unparalleled living experience.
  • Proximity to Dubai Hills Mall for premier shopping experiences.
  • Flexible payment plans to suit diverse financial needs.

image.name: Berkeley by Soho at Dubai Hills Estate

location_tile.title: Dubai Hills Estate Is Known for Its Commitment to Excellence and a Holistic Living Environment.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Berkely by Soho is located in the Dubai Hills Estate community. In this area, residents enjoy a sophisticated lifestyle with a focus on wellness and leisure. The community is equipped with state-of-the-art fitness centers, swimming pools, and sports facilities to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. Families can benefit from top-tier educational institutions within the vicinity, ensuring high-quality education for children.

  • 15 Minutes to Burj Khalifa
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Mall
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 12 Minutes to the Mall of the Emirates
  • 12 Minutes to Meydan Racecourse
